verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships official SDKs across many languages and frameworks: Node, Python (with an async client), iOS, Laravel, TanStack Start, React, Astro and Next.js. The GitHub-published Node SDK documents concrete behaviors such as automatic retries with exponential backoff and public-client initialization. An OpenAPI spec and llms.txt also support AI-native building. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience, since community feedback praises ease of integration only in general terms.
